summary: Correct PR #37 behavioral-evidence design after focused review: preserve OH-03 as compatible but not preferred, classify WA-EVAL-031..033 as repository-visible regression cases only, add oracle-free stimulus-only probes with isolated exact-revision operational bundles, and bind trial capture to concrete bundle identity, context hashes, instance/session provenance and pre-oracle raw-response persistence.

requirements.rationale: The operationalization snapshot maps current real-use gaps to existing Requirements without changing Requirement text, criticality or authority. Future activation may re-evaluate whether refinement is needed.

issues_findings.rationale: The routing mechanism and referential-fidelity residual remain confirmed. A later focused review found that WA-EVAL-031..033 could not support independent blind evidence because their expect fields were repository-visible. The correction explicitly downgrades them to regression-only and introduces a separate oracle-free, isolated-bundle, two-phase probe protocol. OH-03 wording is also kept non-preferential.

risks.rationale: The correction reduces false-assurance risk: prompt-level oracle omission is no longer treated as repository-level blindness. Trial capture now records concrete bundle identity, file hashes, exact revision, instance/session provenance and declared oracle/repository/prior-trial isolation. These integrity controls do not overclaim semantic correctness or true freshness.

decisions_concepts.rationale: WA-EVAL-031..033 remain visible regression cases only. Independent behavioral evidence must use stimulus-only probes RP-41B7/RP-8C2E/RP-D594 delivered through an isolated exact-revision operational bundle, with raw response persisted before oracle reveal. OH-03 remains a compatible open system-function hypothesis, not the preferred interpretation. No new Building Block, registry, authority class, priority or implementation authority is created.

derived_views.rationale: Refresh derived current-state provenance to the behavioral-evidence validity correction; baseline counts and execution authority remain unchanged.

planning_execution_cursor.rationale: Behavioral-evidence correction does not change programme priority or P2 authority. PR #37 remains candidate/review work; P2 remains independently blocked on explicit Human implementation admission with implementation_allowed=false.

active_work.rationale: No OC or P2 implementation is activated. The evidence-design Correction is reconciled. Independent fresh-instance probe execution and focused qualitative re-review remain separate promotion-readiness evidence gates, not unresolved reconciliation conflicts.
